name: Sandbox Loop
author: Brandon
description: Sources and Removers for an endless, self-balancing system. A Source emits a chosen material at an adjustable particles/sec; a Remover deletes one chosen material at an adjustable rate. Set the material + rate on the on-screen panel, then place the structure — each one bakes in the settings that were showing when you placed it, so you can run many different sources and sinks at once.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the Sandbox Loop panel and its Source/Remover behaviour off without unsubscribing.

showTracker.descriptionKey: Show the live Balance section on the panel: each material's effective emit/s, remove/s and net rate, with a surplus / deficit verdict. Turn off to hide it (the Source/Remover controls stay).
